decisions.boundary_condition: Treat the balcony as a soft amenity preference and do not infer a particular view type; a first-floor room can be acceptable without a balcony.
decisions.canonical_value: Softly prefer a hotel room with a balcony, accepting a terrace as a substitute and allowing a first-floor room or an otherwise suitable room without either.
decisions.condition: When searching for, selecting, or booking a hotel room
decisions.default_action: Prioritize rooms with a balcony when available, confirm availability, and consider a terrace as an acceptable substitute.
decisions.exception_condition: Relax the preference when the current request deprioritizes it or suitable balcony or terrace rooms are unavailable, and do not reject an otherwise suitable hotel solely for lacking them.
decisions.name: hotel_room_balcony_preference
decisions.preference_value: Prefer a hotel room with a balcony; a terrace may be an acceptable substitute.
decisions.rationale: Both instances express the same soft hotel-room balcony preference. The second adds terrace as an acceptable substitute, while the frozen representative supplies the first-floor boundary and the general fallback when no balcony is available; these details form one coherent conditional policy without implying a preferred view.
